 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Dev Ittycheria. Dev is the CEO of MongoDB, the developer of data platform with tens of thousands of customers in 100 different countries. He joined the company as CEO in 2014, taking it public in 2017 and now approaching a decade of leading MongoDB to become a go-to choice for the most sophisticated organizations around the world.
